fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) released the REET Mains Result 2026  on 11th June 2026 for the Rajasthan 3rd Grade Teacher recruitment exam conducted from 17th January to 21st January 2026. The recruitment fills 7,759 teacher vacancies across Level 1 (Primary Teacher) & Level 2 (Upper Primary Teacher) posts. Candidates can check the result, merit list, scorecard and category-wise cut-off marks online on the official website at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in 2026. The REET Result 2026 Out For Level 1 enables candidates who are qualified to go ahead to the Pre-Document Verification & Document Verification stages of the selection process.

REET Mains Result 2026 Out

The REET Mains Result 2026 is officially declared by the Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB) for primary school teacher posts. Candidates who participated in the mains exam conducted on 17th January 2026 can access the selection lists on the rssb gov.in website. The state administration published the list of selected candidates to speed up the confirmation process. Shortlisted candidates must now prepare the official paperwork for the mandatory verification rounds starting in June.

The administrative department announced separate performance lists for both Scheduled Areas (TSP) & Non-Scheduled Areas (NTSP). A vast number of applicants registered for the state-level teaching exam making it a highly competitive environment. Checking the REET Level 1 Result 2026 gives an immediate access to the qualifying status & normalized subject marks.

REET Mains Result 2026 Official Website

Many candidates are searching for the REET Mains Result 2026 official website to check their results, merit lists & scorecards. The official portal for accessing the result is rssb.rajasthan.gov.in 2026 where candidates can find the latest notifications related to Level 1 & Level 2 teacher recruitment. Through rssb gov.in aspirants can access the REET Level 1 Result 2026, cut-off marks & merit list PDFs. Candidates are advised to visit the official website on a regular basis for updates regarding document verification, scrutiny forms & final selection procedures.

REET Level 1 Result 2026 Merit List PDF Download Link @rssb.rajasthan.gov.in

The REET Level 1 Result 2026 merit list PDF download link is officially live on the official website of Rajasthan Staff Selection Board which is rssb gov.in. Candidates who appeared for the primary teacher exam (Classes 1 to 5) can view the roll-number-wise shortlisting files. The board has selected candidates up to 2 times the number of available vacancies for the initial certificate verification phase. The selection lists are arranged by subject & region to make the validation process clear for users.

Aspirants can use the REET mains result 2026 level 1 pdf download feature to check the qualification status on offline storage devices. The board has published individual links for the selection wings to accommodate primary teachers across both General Education & Sanskrit Education departments. Candidates must find the credentials within the REET result level 1 list to qualify for the next stage.

What Are The Steps To Download REET Mains Result 2026?

Follow the below steps to download the RSSB REET mains result 2026 :

  • Open the web browser & go directly to the official portal at rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.
  • Click on the “Results” on the homepage.
  • Select the link named “REET Mains Result 2026 Out For Level 1” or specific Sanskrit Education list.
  • The level 1 result document will open on the system screen in a PDF viewer layout.
  • Press Ctrl + F & type the roll number to find the selection status in the file.
  • Download the REET 1 result 2026 document & print a copy for the document verification folder.

REET Mains Score Card 2026

The REET Mains Result 2026 scorecard has been released by the board to show candidates the detailed sectional marks breakdown. While the general merit lists are accessible to all users downloading individual scorecards needs entering personal login details. Aspirants can log into the integrated registration portal using the application number & date of birth. The feature lets candidates review the performance details and see how normalized scaling adjusted the raw marks.

The scorecard shows details like candidate name, category allocation, raw score & final marks evaluated. Shortlisted candidates should save the certificate as it is a required document during the evaluation rounds. If a candidate notices a technical typo or name discrepancy on the sheet they should contact the board’s helpdesk immediately to request a correction before final appointments.

REET Mains Cut Off 2026

The REET Mains Cut Off 2026 represents the minimum marks needed for candidates to qualify for the next stage of the recruitment process. The Rajasthan Staff Selection Board determines the cut-off after considering the difficulty level of the exam, total vacancies, number of candidates appearing & performance. Candidates securing marks equal to or above the given cut-off are included in the provisional merit list. The REET cut-off varies across categories & recruitment areas like TSP & Non-TSP regions. The official RSMSSB result notification has released the category-wise cut-off marks for result candidates.

Candidates who appeared in the REET Mains exam can now download their result. The candidates who qualify the REET Mains exam will be appointed as a Rajasthan 3rd grade teacher as a primary teacher in rajasthan State. Stay connected with us to get all the updates regarding REET Mains Result 2026.

Does RSSB reserve the right to modify the declared result if errors are found?

Yes, the board explicitly retains all administrative rights to revise or rectify the results if any recording inconsistencies or anomalies are discovered later.

Is the REET Level 1 selection subject to any pending court cases?

Yes, this examination result remains strictly subject to the final judicial outcomes of Civil Writ Petitions 19070/2025, 19009/2025, 600/2026, and 240/2026 pending in the High Court.

Updated on: 12 Jun 2026 | 01:10:44 PM IST

Which appendices in the official notification contain the roll numbers of qualified candidates?

The roll-number lists, categorized by merit and division, are attached at the end of the document across Appendix-1 to Appendix-4.

Open the downloaded PDF file, press Ctrl + F (or use the search icon on mobile), and type your roll number to see if you are provisionally shortlisted.

What are the primary category cut-off marks for the Scheduled Area (TSP) in REET Level 1?

The cut-off marks for TSP regions are 161.0120 for General (UR)/Female, 148.3118 for SC, and 135.0791 for ST candidates.

Updated on: 12 Jun 2026 | 09:10:40 AM IST

Updated on: 12 Jun 2026 | 08:10:44 AM IST

In the NTSP region, the final cut-off score is fixed at 178.5612 for OBC candidates and 173.0695 for EWS candidates.

Updated on: 12 Jun 2026 | 07:10:30 AM IST

What is the REET Level 1 NTSP cut-off for the General (UR) category?

The cut-off mark for General (UR) and Female candidates in Non-Scheduled Areas (NTSP) is 185.7026.

Updated on: 12 Jun 2026 | 06:10:51 AM IST

What is the statutory minimum passing mark required for the Sanskrit Education Department?

Candidates must score a minimum baseline of 40% (relaxed to 35% for SC/ST/Sahariya/Divyangjan and 30% for Ex-Servicemen) to qualify for Sanskrit education posts.

Updated on: 12 Jun 2026 | 05:10:28 AM IST

Why were 5,761 candidates declared disqualified in the REET Level 1 result?

Exactly 5,761 candidates were disqualified because they left more than 10% of the questions completely blank or failed to darken any option circle on their OMR sheets.

What are the online Scrutiny Form submission dates for REET Level 1 candidates?

Provisionally shortlisted Level 1 candidates must fill out the online Detailed Application-cum-Scrutiny Form from June 18, 2026, to July 2, 2026.

The board has shortlisted approximately 2 times (200%) the number of advertised vacancies for the screening and document verification round.

When was the written examination for REET Level 1 conducted?

The written examination for Level 1 (Classes 1 to 5) was held on January 17, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM.

total of 7,449 primary teacher posts are being filled, including 7,000 for Elementary Education and 449 for Sanskrit Education.

The official website to check the result and download the merit list is www.rssb.rajasthan.gov.in.

REET Mains Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is the REET Mains Result 2026 released?

Yes the REET Mains Result 2026 has been released by RSSB for Level 1 teacher recruitment posts.

Q2. How can the candidates download the REET mains result 2026 level 1 PDF?

Candidates can download the merit list PDF from the official website i.e. rssb.rajasthan.gov.in 2026 through the section of REET Mains Result 2026.

Q3. Is REET Result 2026 Out For Level 1?

Yes the REET Result 2026 Out For Level 1 has been released for Primary Teacher recruitment.

Q4. Has the REET mains result 2026 level 2 been released?

Yes the REET mains result 2026 level 2 has not been released yet for various Upper Primary Teacher subjects.

Q5. What details are mentioned in the REET Mains Score Card 2026?

The REET Mains Result 2026 and scorecard contains the candidate’s name, roll number, category, marks obtained, normalized score & qualifying status.
